skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand, analyze and apply general knowledge about the concept, existence and development of environmental law, regulated objects, methods of regulation, sources of law and basic content structure of Vietnamese environmental law.
Understand and apply basic knowledge about international environmental law.
Analyze and apply laws regulating environmental impact assessment.
Analyze and apply laws regulating air pollution control.
Analyze and apply laws regulating water pollution control.
Analyze and apply laws regulating soil and forest conservation.
Analyze and apply mechanisms for resolving environmental disputes.
Apply communication, presentation, and public speaking skills.
Apply computer usage skills for searching legal documents and information in the field of environmental protection.
Apply information analysis skills for legal situations arising in the field of environmental protection.
Apply problem-solving skills for legal issues.
Develop self-study skills to accumulate and enhance knowledge.
Develop planning and implementation skills, propose initiatives during task execution.
